name: hmziq-brand
description: The hmziq brand, one kit that installs into every hmziq site and app: a framework-free core, a Svelte kit and an Astro kit. See docs/README.md.

scripts.build: bun run --filter @hmziq/brand-core build && bun run --filter svelte-app build && bun run --filter astro-app build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @hmziq/brand-core build && tsc -b && bun run --filter @hmziq/brand-astro typecheck && bun run --filter astro-app typecheck
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run check:kit && bun run check:motion && bun run check:colors && bun run check:contrast && bun run check:brand-kit && bun run check:assets && bun run check:parity
scripts.check:kit: bun run --filter @hmziq/brand-svelte check && bun run --filter svelte-app check
